integrity: The proof is a projective conic character-sum calculation plus a complementary-unitary singular-value identity. The standalone checker corroborates q=3,5,7,9; it is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only; the trace pairing is degenerate on the symmetric subspace in characteristic two. The theorem concerns complex linear Fourier recovery, not phase retrieval, erasures, higher symmetric matrix sizes, or all historical priority.
title: Three-level self-Fourier sampling on nonsingular symmetric binary forms
